name: LIVING MUD SCRUM — Sprint 1: mine the deep history (Reddit DnD + estate muds + Nacho inspiration)

lanes.prompt: You are a game-design miner. Fetch https://old.reddit.com/r/DNDDIY/top.json?t=all&limit=25 (add User-Agent header Mozilla/5.0 in your fetch tool; if .json fails, fetch the HTML listing). Extract: the 10 best DIY dungeon/game-building posts — what mechanics they describe, what materials they use, what makes them fun. Focus on physical/printed dungeons, paper mods, homebrew systems. For each: title, mechanic, and one line on how a text-MUD could borrow it. Structured findings.

You are a game-design miner. Fetch https://old.reddit.com/r/RPGdesign/top.json?t=year&limit=25 (User-Agent Mozilla/5.0; fallback to HTML listing). Extract the 10 best posts about: solo RPG engines, AI-enhanced tabletop, oracle systems, play-by-post design. For each: mechanic, why it works, and one line on grafting into a text MUD where an LLM narrates but an engine owns truth. Structured findings.

You are a MUD historian. Fetch https://old.reddit.com/r/MUDgames/top.json?t=all&limit=25 and https://old.reddit.com/r/MUD/top.json?t=all&limit=25 (User-Agent Mozilla/5.0; fallback HTML). Extract: the most-praised MUD design ideas — room descriptions, NPC dialogue systems, persistence, world state, player-driven story. For each: the idea, the source post, and one line on implementing it in a browser MUD backed by a deterministic engine. Structured findings.

You are the estate archivist. Read these files: dashboard/static/games/mud.html (124KB — sample the room structures, save system, dialogue patterns), watch/inbox/PRATCHETT_MUD_SELF_STEAL_20260918.md, corpus/oral_history/nacho_archaeology/extracted/nacho-archaeology-part1-chats-produced/produced/STEAL_DND_MUD_WOW_UI.md if present, and watch/inbox/FROM_MUD_TO_WOW_20260914.md. Extract: the mud.html engine's actual systems (rooms, movement parser, NPC patterns, persistence), the Discworld mud rules, and the 5 mechanics worth carrying into a new browser MUD backed by a deterministic engine. Cite what you read.

You are the operator's muse. Read corpus/canon/THE_PARABLE_OF_THE_FIELD_AND_THE_STONES.md + corpus/oral_history/LETTER_TO_DAUGHTER.md (the GPS for problems addendum) + watch/inbox/SHITPOST_DESK_ANTHROPIC_PRIMER_20260922.md (the Diamond Age sections) + watch/inbox/BUILD_ORDER_LIVING_MUD_20260922.md. Mine them for game-able material: which images (field, stones, bubbles, GPS-for-problems, the door doctrine, whirlwind of joy) could become MUD rooms, NPC voices, or puzzle mechanics? For each: the image, the game-able form, and the room name. This is for the operator's daughter's inheritance — make it worthy. Under 1200 words.

You are the operator's muse, X division. Read the estate's own record of the operator's game-related posts: watch/inbox/GAMES_SITE_PLAYTEST_20260921.md (his live playtest feedback), corpus/canon/founding_curriculum/ (sample 3 files), and memory/runs/ghost/frustration.jsonl (his corrections ARE design reviews). Extract: his game-design instincts as 8 design principles in his own spirit (e.g. 'rebuild from player feedback same night', 'steal mechanics from genres', 'the mechanic IS the teaching'), each with the receipt that proves it. Under 1000 words.
